apply_phong_shading: apply per pixel Phong shading to rasterized meshes using lights, cameras, materials, and texels
apply_gouraud_shading: apply per vertex Gouraud shading to meshes with TexturesVertex using lights, cameras, and materials
apply_flat_shading: apply per face flat shading to rasterized meshes using face normals, lights, and materials
apply_lighting_to_points: compute ambient, diffuse, and specular lighting components for 3D points given normals, lights, and materials
apply_phong_shading_with_pixels: apply Phong shading and return both pixel colors and camera coordinates of each intersection
